Chapter 914: Chapter 15: The Conduit Of Space-Time (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 914: Chapter 15: The Conduit of Space-Time (Please Subscribe)

For the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss, be it the Immortal Realm or the Demon Abyss itself, there are basically no secrets.

Once he locks onto a living being, no matter where they are, even if they are in the Primordial Lands of the Immortal Realm, they cannot escape.

But now?

The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss wishes to lock onto Lin Yuan’s exact position, yet he finds it utterly impossible to determine the coordinates.

This vexes and confounds the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss.

It’s like having someone right in front of you, you can see them, but you can’t touch them.

The stronger and higher the life form, the more perplexed they are when faced with such a scene. “What’s going on?”

The expression of the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss turned serious, and the consciousness that had only partially awakened is now continuing to stir.

If at first he was merely curious as to why the Emperor of Demonic Beings he regarded as children were dying and falling, intending to find the perpetrator to exact revenge before slipping back into slumber, that was all.

But now, the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss has become thoroughly intrigued. “Causal connections…”

Countless threads of fate appeared before the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss.

As an Ancestral Master, the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss naturally has a profound understanding of the laws of cause and effect.

Although he had never met Lin Yuan in person, the latter had killed six Emperor of Demonic Beings and countless demonic beings.

The Emperor of Demonic Beings and the demonic beings are part of the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss, especially the Emperor of Demonic Beings, akin to his progeny, with a close connection to his incarnation.

Lin Yuan killing the Emperor of Demonic Beings equates to establishing a direct causal link with the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss.

Utilizing this causal connection, the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss could easily lock onto Lin Yuan’s precise location.

Whoosh.

The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss has a multitude of causal threads, connecting different places in the Immortal Realm and the Demon Abyss, some even extending beyond the Immortal Realm.

The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss immediately found the causal thread related to Lin Yuan and followed the trail. “Hmm?” “Still can’t sense it?”

The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss was astonished.

The existence of the causal thread proves that the other party has not died.

Yet alive and undying, they could not be located within the range through the causal thread.

Following that, the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss employed dozens of methods attempting to lock onto Lin Yuan’s coordinates, all to no avail.

Even though it was clear Lin Yuan was still alive and indeed within the Immortal Realm, within the Xuantian Immortal Domain, the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss still felt as if he was grasping at a flower in the mirror, a moon in the water. “It’s time and space, a deeper level of time and space.”

The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss sat on his throne, his brow furrowed.

After various probes, the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss concluded —

The being that killed the Emperor of Demonic Beings exists in an extremely deep part of space-time.

Even he could not forcefully peer into and locate it. “To venture into such depths of space-time, one must possess a certain level of understanding of it, at least beyond mine…”

The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss thought quietly. Being at the level of an Ancestral Master, who could have an understanding of space-time that surpassed his? Could it be that a new Ancestral Master had been born in the Immortal Realm?

But how could that be possible? The celestial phenomena triggered by stepping into the level of an Ancestral Master could not be concealed, and it was virtually impossible for any being in the Immortal Realm or the Demon Abyss to step into that level at present. “It’s not an Ancestral Master.”

The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss was very certain in his heart. “What exactly has happened during my slumber?”

The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss wondered to himself. Although certain that the assailant was not an Ancestral Master, the inability to lock onto their position meant that they were untouchable. “Return, all of you.”

The Ancestor of the Demon Abyss couldn’t pinpoint Lin Yuan, but since he had acted against the Emperor of Demonic Beings, he presumably didn’t have much affinity for the demonic beings of the Demon Abyss.

Hence, the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss immediately began summoning all of the relentless demonic beings and Emperor of Demonic Beings that had invaded the Immortal Realm back.

The so-called war between the immortals and demons was merely a game for the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss; even if those demonic beings and the Emperor of Demonic Beings devoured many immortals, it would not be of much help to him, the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss. …

Canghai Immortal City.

Four mighty Emperor of Demonic Beings looked down coldly, as the vast Immortal City below was on the brink of collapse under the onslaught of countless demonic beings.

The Immortal City’s sovereign and many top-ranking Jade Immortals fought desperately, to no avail; before absolute power, all resistance and struggle were futile. “Hahahaha.” “Delicious food.”

The four Emperor of Demonic Beings gazed greedily at the Immortal City below.

Devouring immortals and devouring their own kind were completely different experiences, and the help it provided to themselves was different as well.

Just then— “Return, all of you.”

A deep voice echoed in the minds of the four Emperor of Demonic Beings. “Father God? Father God is calling us back?”

The four Emperor of Demonic Beings were shocked. They originated from the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss, so they also considered the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss as ‘Father God’. “Let’s go back.” “Father God wants us back, there must be something important.”

The four Emperor of Demonic Beings reluctantly looked down at the Immortal City below; they were just moments away from having that delicious food in their mouths.

But none dared defy the command of the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss; it was an instinct embedded deep within their consciousness.

Swoosh swoosh swoosh!

The four Emperor of Demonic Beings willingly retreated, and the infinite demonic beings also quickly dissipated.

In just a short moment, the demonic beings outside Canghai Immortal City all but vanished. “What… what is going on?”

The sovereign of Canghai Immortal City thought he was sure to perish.

Even if he had left measures to save his life elsewhere, if he were to die at the hands of the Emperor of Demonic Beings, the terrible corruption at the level of the soul could render those measures useless.

But now?

All the Emperor of Demonic Beings have retreated? “We… we survived…”

Inside Canghai Immortal City, countless Immortals wept with joy as they had never expected to live; those ferocious and ferocious demons had retreated on their own accords.
